blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.
blocks.zh: 长期剂随着相互作用的展开而积累了大型的外部记忆存储,增加了存储,检索和响应生成的成本. 效率受到两个因素的制约:记录数的增加增加了检索费,而检索时间较长增加了预填计算和解码时间注意费用。 现有方法对记录进行prune或合并,但进行搜索可能会丢弃有用的证据,而合并则可能产生更少但更长的检索单元。 我们引入了MemFolder,一个结构制导的内存折叠框架,它相继降低了记录的计数和上下文长度. 该框架由两个核心部分组成,共享记忆组,使用跨记录结构指导证据合并和紧凑表述。 RecordFolder ground 实体提及,逐步选择具有代表性但互为补充的锚,并将语义和实体亲和性与时间链结合,将兼容的记录整合为更少的检索单元. 上下文Folder将这些组中的原始记录编码为紧凑文本,并在关键事实无法找到时使用校验反馈来修改编码. 关于基于文本的三个内存基准LoCoMo、PersonaMem和LongMemEval以及两个多式联运基准M3-Bench-web和M3-Bench-robot的实验,显示了我们方法的有力性能。 值得注意的是,在Mem0上,RecordFolder保留了三个基于文本的基准的最初平均业绩的99.0%,减少了50%的记录,在保留业绩方面超过了最强的基准1.9个百分点。 结合ContextFolder,现有的记录压缩方法进一步缩短其输出记录,同时保留大部分性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Advances in reasoning and tool use enable large language models ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ; Kimi Team et al., 2026a ; Kimi Team et al., 2026b ) to support long-term agents operating across multiple sessions ( Wu et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2026 ) . These agents draw on earlier conversations, observations, and task states to inform later decisions. External memory systems ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) index this growing history as natural-language records for retrieval. Our uncompressed stores contain 6,817 records totaling 61,273 tokens across all ten LoCoMo samples ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) , and 310,120 records totaling 3.7M tokens across LongMemEval ( Wu et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: This growth creates two coupled efficiency bottlenecks , as shown in Figure 1 (1). A larger record count requires more storage, increases the size of the index, and expands the retrieval search space. Once the records have been retrieved, their combined context length determines how much memory text the agent processes per query. Even individually short records can form a long context when retrieved together, increasing both prefilling and decoding costs ( Liu et al., 2025b ) .

Figure 1 (2) plots record count N N on the horizontal axis and tokens per unit ℓ \ell on the vertical axis.
Prompt compressors such as LLMLingua ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Pan et al., 2024 ) and BabelTele ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) shorten the input to each call while leaving N N unchanged.
StreamMeCo ( Wang et al., 2026a ) and MemForest ( Wang et al., 2026b ) reduce N N by pruning or consolidating records. Pruning can discard useful evidence. Consolidation preserves related content but can produce fewer, longer units, shifting the store toward the upper left in the figure.
On LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) , when 50% of records are retained, units produced by MemForest and ToMe ( Bolya et al., 2023 ) average 2.12 × 2.12\times and 2.48 × 2.48\times the original record length, respectively. At 30% retention, the ratios rise to 3.01 × 3.01\times and 3.87 × 3.87\times .
Even concatenation without merging yields units 2.10 × 2.10\times the original length at 50% retention.
With a fixed top- k k retrieval budget, fewer units can still yield a longer context . We aim to reduce both costs while retaining evidence an agent may need in later sessions.

blocks.en:
This observation motivates two distinct compression decisions.
At the record level , we determine which records can share a retrieval unit while preserving complementary facts and state changes.
At the context level , we determine how to encode each group compactly, expressing shared content once while retaining dates and other record-specific details.
Group assignments connect these decisions while allowing record count and context length to be optimized separately.
blocks.zh:
这一观察激励了两个截然不同的压缩决定.
在记录层面,我们确定哪些记录可以共享检索单位,同时保留补充事实和状态变化。
在上下文一级,我们确定如何对每个组进行紧凑的编码,在保留日期和其他具体记录细节的同时,一次表达共享内容。
分组任务将这些决定连接起来,同时允许记录计数和上下文长度分别优化.

blocks.en:
We address these two efficiency bottlenecks with MemFolder , a structure-guided memory folding framework with two complementary folding components. As shown in Figure 1 (3), RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate N N records into K K retrieval units.
Given these groups and their source records, ContextFolder generates compact encodings guided by a target token ratio while keeping one output unit per group.
Verification feedback guides revisions when key facts are not recoverable.
Given that it is independent of the grouping algorithm, ContextFolder can also shorten the contexts from record compression methods.

blocks.en:
Experiments cover three text benchmarks and two multimodal settings.
With 50% fewer records, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of average Mem0 performance across the three text benchmarks, compared with 97.1% for MemForest.
Combined with RecordFolder, ContextFolder further cuts tokens per record by 40%, 38%, and 31% on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and M3-Bench-robot, respectively, with limited accuracy loss.
As a plug-and-play component, ContextFolder also shortens outputs from other record-compression methods, yielding more favorable accuracy–efficiency trade-offs than BabelTele and LLMLingua-2.

We develop RecordFolder to consolidate records through progressive anchor selection and entity-aware temporal chaining. blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
LLM Agent Memory Systems. Memory systems preserve information from past interactions for use beyond the current context window.
Token-level external memory retains explicit records that can be inspected, updated, and retrieved without modifying model parameters.
Generative Agents ( Park et al., 2023 ) stores observations and reflections in a memory stream, while MemGPT ( Packer et al., 2023 ) manages information across memory tiers.
Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) extracts and consolidates salient facts from conversations, and A-MEM ( Xu et al., 2025 ) organizes structured notes through dynamically generated links.
LightMem ( Fang et al., 2026 ) organizes interactions across sensory, topic-aware short-term, and sleep-time consolidation stages, whereas REMem ( Shu et al., 2026 ) links semantically related episodic memories with compact gists and temporal facts to support iterative agentic retrieval.
Other approaches maintain experience in latent representations or model parameters.
MemoryLLM ( Wang et al., 2024 ) uses a fixed-size, self-updatable latent memory pool, whereas TMEM ( Ren et al., 2026 ) incorporates distilled experience through online updates to fast LoRA weights.
These forms can coexist: MemOS ( Li et al., 2025 ) unifies the management of plaintext, activation-based, and parameter-level memories.
Our work focuses on accumulated external records, whose count and textual content determine the size of the store and the evidence available for retrieval.
Rather than introducing another memory architecture, MemFolder compresses these records within existing systems while preserving text for retrieval and generation.
blocks.zh:
LLM 语言 代理内存系统。 内存系统从过去的互动中保存信息,供当前上下文窗口之外使用.
Token级别外部内存保留了可以检查,更新和检索而不修改模型参数的明确记录.
Generative Agents(Park等人,2023年)将观测和反射存储在一个内存流中,而MemGPT(Packer等人,2023年)管理跨内存层的信息.
Mem0(Chhikara等人,2025年)从对话中提取和整理突出的事实,A-MEM(徐等人,2025年)通过动态生成的链接组织结构化的笔记.
LightMem(Fang et al., 2026)组织跨越感官,主题认知的短期和睡眠时间合并阶段的相互作用,而REMem(Shu et al., 2026)则将精密相关的偶联记忆与紧凑的腺体和时间事实联系起来,支持迭代代理检索.
其他方法保持潜在表述或模型参数方面的经验。
MemoryLLM(Wang等人,2024年)使用固定大小,可自我更新的潜在内存池,而TMEM(Ren等人,2026年)则通过在线更新将蒸馏经验融入快速LORA重量.
这些形式可以共存: MemOS(Li等人,2025年)统一了Plaintext的管理,基于激活,以及参数级记忆.
我们的工作重点是累积的外部记录,这些记录的清点和文字内容决定了商店的规模和可供检索的证据。
与其引入另一个内存架构,MemFolder在保存文本供检索和生成的同时,会在现有系统内压缩这些记录.

blocks.en:
Long-Term Memory Compression. Memory efficiency can be improved during construction, maintenance, or inference.
MemoryBank ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) updates retention through forgetting and reinforcement, while SimpleMem ( Liu et al., 2026a ) constructs compact memory units and recursively consolidates related content.
At inference time, LLMLingua ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) shortens prompts, whereas token-level compression methods ( Li et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026c ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Lin et al., 2026 ) reduce the states retained during generation.
These inference-side interventions do not by themselves reduce the number of records in a persistent external store.
We study post-construction compression before retrieval, so compressed records can be reused across queries.
blocks.zh:
长期记忆压缩. 在建造,维护,或推论期间,可以提高内存效率.
MemoryBank(Zhong et al., 2024)通过忘却和加固更新保留,而SimleMem(Liu et al., 2026a)则构建紧凑的内存单元,并递归整合相关内容.
LLMLingua在推论时 (Jiang等人,2023年)缩短了提示,而象征级的压缩方法(Li等人,2024年;Liu等人,2026年b;Liu等人,2026年c;Liu等人,2025年a;Lin等人,2026年)减少了世代保留下来的状态.
这些推论方面的干预本身并不能减少长期对外储存的记录数量。
我们研究在检索之前的建筑后压缩,因此压缩记录可以跨查询重复使用.

blocks.en:
Post-construction methods reduce existing stores through pruning or consolidation.
StreamMeCo ( Wang et al., 2026a ) prunes memory graphs using representative sampling and scores based on entity importance and semantic diversity, without rewriting the retained records.
MemRefine ( Kim et al., 2026 ) uses embedding similarity to propose candidate pairs, then an LLM judge determines whether their factual content warrants deletion, merging, or preservation.
Its refinement loop targets a storage budget measured over serialized entries.
MemForest ( Wang et al., 2026b ) combines global semantic similarity with local temporal continuity to partition memories into EventTrees, then progressively merges records along selected tree edges.
It also introduces anchor-guided propagation retrieval to supplement evidence with temporally related memories.
blocks.zh:
施工后方法通过挤压或合并减少现有库存.
StreamMeCo (Wang et al., 2026a) 利用代表性采样和基于实体重要性和语义多样性的分数来推算内存图,而不重写保留记录.
MemRefine(Kim等人,2026年)使用嵌入式相似性提出候选配对,然后由LLM法官决定其实际内容是否值得删除,合并,或保留.
其精细的循环针对的是相对于序列化条目的存储预算.
MemForest (Wang et al., 2026b) 将全球语义相似性和局部时间连续性结合到分割记忆到EventTrees中,然后沿着选定的树缘逐渐合并记录.
它还引入了锚定制导的传播检索,以时间相关记忆补充证据。

blocks.en:
MemFolder targets both record count and per-unit context length.
Unlike end-to-end memory systems ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Shu et al., 2026 ) , which either merge records without bounding per-unit token expansion or expand stores with multi-granularity graph nodes and multi-step retrieval, MemFolder operates as a plug-and-play post-construction layer that jointly folds record count and per-unit length over existing stores.
Compared with EventTree-based merging ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , RecordFolder groups records around progressively selected anchors and refines assignments through entity-aware temporal chains.
ContextFolder reuses these groups to generate compact encodings under a soft token budget.
It checks whether source-derived facts can be recovered from the encoding without exposing the original records to the reader, and uses the feedback for revision.
This post-encoding check differs from deciding whether a candidate pair should be merged: it evaluates factual recovery from the resulting compact representation.
blocks.zh:
MemFolder的目标既包括记录计数,也包括每个单位的上下文长度.
不同于端到端内存系统 (刘等人,2026a; Fang et al., 2026 ; Shu et al., 2026 ),要么在不限制每个单位的令牌扩展范围的情况下合并记录,要么用多格勒图节点和多步检索方式扩展商店,MemFolder作为插件和游戏后建筑层运作,在现有商店上共同折叠记录计数和每个单位长度.
与基于事件Tree的合并(Wang et al., 2026b)相比,RecordFolder组在逐渐选定的主播周围进行记录,并通过实体意识时间链完善任务.
ContextFolder再利用这些组来生成软符号预算下的紧凑编码.
它检查来源出的事实是否可以在不向读者披露原始记录的情况下从编码中恢复,并利用反馈进行修改.
这种编码后核对不同于决定是否应合并候选人对数:它评价了由此产生的契约代表制的实际恢复情况。

blocks.en: Figure 2 presents the pipelines of our MemFolder, which addresses both memory costs by sequentially folding the record store along two axes. RecordFolder grounds records, selects representative and complementary anchors, refines group assignments using entity, semantic, and temporal relations, and consolidates each group into one retrieval unit. ContextFolder reuses these groups to generate compact grammar-based encodings under group-specific budgets: a planner identifies facts to preserve, a compressor rewrites each group, and a verifier checks recovery from the encoding alone. Thus, retrieval accesses fewer units with less context in each.

blocks.en:
Consolidating records can reduce the number of retrieval units while lengthening each one; at a fixed retrieval top- k k , this need not reduce the context passed to the agent. ContextFolder compresses the original records within each assigned group guided by a target fraction of source tokens, without changing group membership.
A planner labels facts by importance and inferability and prepares QA checks. A compressor generates candidate encodings, and a blind verifier tests whether a reader can recover the facts from the encoding alone.
Feedback on missing facts and token usage guides revision while preserving each group’s assignment and target ratio throughout compression.

Verifier: Blind Recovery Check. Separate answering and judging calls evaluate each candidate.
A blind reader receives the encoding, grammar legend, and verification questions, but not the source records or expected answers.

We select the shortest candidate recovering all required facts.

Main Comparisons. Table 1 compares RecordFolder with record-compression baselines on Mem0 at 30%, 50%, and 70% record-count reduction.
Figure 3 (a) and (b) compare context-compression methods after three record compressors at 50% reduction. (i) RecordFolder leads at every ratio. It achieves the highest mean accuracy across the three benchmarks at every tested ratio.
At 50% reduction, it retains 99.0% of original performance, compared with 97.1% for MemForest.
At 70%, these values are 96.6% and 93.3%, respectively. (ii) Consolidation benefits LongMemEval. At 50% reduction, RecordFolder scores 55.0 on LongMemEval, versus 51.8 for MemForest and 50.8 for ToMe.
Its 3.2-point lead over MemForest exceeds the 0.9-point gap on LoCoMo.
At 70% reduction, it maintains 55.0, compared with 52.2 for MemForest and 49.6 for ToMe.
These results suggest that RecordFolder is particularly effective at preserving useful evidence when compressing long interaction histories. (iii) ContextFolder improves cross-method trade-offs. On LoCoMo, BabelTele increases tokens per record after all three record compressors.
After RecordFolder, tokens rise from 20.6 to 27.3 while accuracy drops from 59.3% to 49.3%.
This may reflect tokenization overhead from multilingual and symbolic rewriting of compact records.
On LongMemEval, BabelTele shortens RecordFolder’s output, but ContextFolder achieves higher accuracy with fewer tokens: 51.8% at 13.4 tokens per record, versus 45.8% at 17.2.
ContextFolder also shortens MemForest and ToMe outputs on both benchmarks.
After RecordFolder, it exceeds LLMLingua-2 by 12.2 and 4.0 accuracy points on LoCoMo and LongMemEval, respectively, using about 1.5 additional tokens per record.
After RecordFolder halves the record count, ContextFolder further reduces tokens per record by 40.3% and 37.9% on the two benchmarks, respectively.

blocks.en:
Effects of Each Design. Table 4 evaluates anchor selection in RecordFolder.
DPC achieves the best average accuracy of 57.2 and the highest LoCoMo score of 59.3, while MinMax leads on LongMemEval with 55.6.
This indicates that progressive density-and-novelty selection balances local representativeness and complementary coverage.
Table 5 isolates the assignment signals.
The full model averages 57.2; removing cosine similarity causes the largest drop of 3.4 points, compared with 1.9, 1.1, and 0.6 points for gain gating, entity affinity, and temporal chaining.
These results identify embedding similarity as the main semantic signal, with the other terms refining entity and temporal consistency.
Table 6 compares pruning and merging with DPC anchors fixed.
Merging averages 57.2, 6.1 points above pruning and only 0.9 and 0.2 points below the uncompressed scores on LoCoMo and LongMemEval.
This mirrors Tables 1 and 2 , where merging also performs better under record reduction.
Table 7 evaluates ContextFolder after 50% record reduction.
The full model achieves 56.6 and 51.8 accuracy with 12.31 and 13.40 tokens per record on LoCoMo and LongMemEval.
Removing the planner lowers accuracy by 0.7 and 0.8 points while increasing token use; removing the verifier saves tokens but costs 1.9 and 1.4 points.
The planner thus improves accuracy and compression, while the verifier strengthens recovery at a small token cost.
Overall, RecordFolder forms stronger retrieval units, and ContextFolder further compresses their contents.

Efficiency Analysis. Figure 4 reports retrieval latency across three text-based and two multimodal settings.
Mean speedups rise from 1.41 1.41 – 1.86 × 1.86\times at 50% retention to 1.88–5.34 × \times at 30%.
At 30% retention, mean latency drops by 56%, 81%, and 72% on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and PersonaMem, respectively; PersonaMem falls from 1,900 to 538 ms.
The largest gain appears on LongMemEval, where the mean speedup grows from 1.45 × 1.45\times at 50% retention to 5.34 × 5.34\times at 30%, while tail latency falls from 97.5 to 15.5 ms.
This parallel reduction in mean and tail latency shows that record compression alleviates expensive retrieval cases, not only the average query cost.
M3-Bench-robot and M3-Bench-web reach 2.30 × 2.30\times and 1.88 × 1.88\times speedups, respectively, although their tail-latency gains are smaller than those on the text benchmarks.
This gap suggests that record retrieval is only one part of the latency in multimodal settings, where additional processing costs remain.
Record compression therefore reduces both average and high-latency retrieval overhead as the external memory grows.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Growing external memory stores increase the storage, retrieval, and generation costs of long-term agents.
To address these costs, we propose MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework comprising two components: RecordFolder and ContextFolder.
The former reduces record count by grouping and consolidating related evidence using semantic, entity, and temporal relations.
The latter further reuses these groups for compact encoding, with fact-recovery checks guiding revisions.
Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the strong performance of RecordFolder under record compression.
Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten retrieval units, reducing both record count and context length.
blocks.zh:
越来越多的外部内存商店增加了长期代理的存储,检索和生成成本.
为了解决这些成本问题,我们提议建立由结构指导的内存折叠框架,由两个部分组成: 记录福德和背景福德.
前者通过使用语义,实体,以及时间关系来组合和合并相关证据来减少记录计数.
后者进一步重新使用这些组别进行紧凑编码,以事实恢复检查指导修改。
跨越多个基准的实验显示记录福尔德在记录压缩下的强性能.
结合ContextFolder,现有的记录压缩方法进一步缩短了检索单元,减少了记录的计数和上下文长度.

blocks.en: We consider both text-based and multimodal memory frameworks: • Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) is a long-term memory system that extracts, updates, stores, and retrieves persistent textual records from agent interactions. We use Mem0 as the primary text-based framework and construct an uncompressed memory store before applying each compression method. • MemOS ( Li et al., 2025 ) is a memory operating system for AI systems that organizes multiple forms of memory, including plaintext, activation, and parametric memory, under a unified management layer. It provides a framework-level setting for studying record compression beyond a single text-memory implementation. • M3-Agent ( Long et al., 2026 ) is a multimodal agent framework that continuously processes video and audio inputs and builds an entity-centric long-term memory. Its memory integrates visual, auditory, and textual information, which supports multi-turn retrieval and reasoning over dynamic environments.

blocks.en: We evaluate long-term memory compression on three conversational benchmarks and two multimodal video benchmarks: • LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) contains long multi-session conversations and questions covering single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, and open-domain reasoning, testing whether an agent can recover evidence distributed across an extended interaction history. • LongMemEval ( Wu et al., 2025 ) evaluates long-term interactive memory with single-session and multi-session questions, preference tracking, knowledge updates, and temporal reasoning. • PersonaMem ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) benchmarks dynamic user profiling and personalized response generation. We use its 32K setting, which tests user-fact recall, preference evolution, recommendation, and generalization across scenarios. • M3-Bench-robot ( Long et al., 2026 ) is an online first-person video benchmark collected from daily robot environments. Its questions require multi-evidence, multi-hop, cross-modal, person-centered, and general-knowledge reasoning over continuously observed interactions. • M3-Bench-web ( Long et al., 2026 ) is an offline web-video benchmark spanning diverse video categories. It evaluates the same long-term multimodal reasoning abilities over prerecorded videos with questions that require evidence from multiple moments and modalities.
blocks.zh: 我们评价三种对话基准和两种多模式视频基准的长期内存压缩: ^ LoCoMo(Maharana等人,2024年)包含长时间的多场谈话和问题,涵盖单跳,多跳,时空和开放域推理,测试一个特工是否能够收回分布在扩展互动历史中的证据. ^ LongMemEval(Wu等人,2025年)评价长期交互内存与单会和多会问题,偏好跟踪,知识更新,以及时间推理. • PersonaMem(Jiang等人,2025年)基准动态用户概况和个性化反应生成。 我们使用它的32K设定,测试用户-事实召回,偏好演变,建议,以及各种情景的概括. • M3-Bench-机器人 (Long et al., 2026)是一个从日常机器人环境收集的在线第一人称视频基准. 它的问题需要多证据、多跳、跨模式、以人为本和一般知识的推理,而不是不断观察到的相互作用。 • M3-奔驰网 (Long et al., 2026)是一个跨多个视频类别的离线网络视频基准. 它比预先录制的视频评价同样的长期多式联运推理能力,其中的问题需要来自多个时刻和模式的证据。

blocks.en: We compare record compression against pruning and merging baselines: • Random Pruning randomly discards records until the target keep ratio is reached. It isolates the effect of record removal without using content, temporal, or graph information. • KMeans ( McQueen, 1967 ) clusters record embeddings into the target number of groups and retains the record closest to each cluster centroid, providing an embedding-space representative-selection baseline. • DART ( Wen et al., 2025 ) is a diversity-based pruning method that removes highly redundant representations by comparing them with a small set of pivot representations. We adapt this operation from visual tokens to memory records. • StreamMeCo ( Wang et al., 2026a ) compresses structured memory graphs with a dual strategy: it samples representatives from isolated nodes and prunes connected nodes using entity importance and semantic similarity. • Random Merging partitions records into retained and removed sets, then randomly assigns removed records to retained records for consolidation until the target keep ratio is reached. • ToMe ( Bolya et al., 2023 ) progressively matches similar representations across two partitions and merges each matched pair. We adapt this token merging procedure to records by matching each record with its most similar counterpart. • MemForest ( Wang et al., 2026b ) combines global semantic similarity with local temporal continuity to partition records into event-centric units. It constructs a maximum-spanning-tree EventTree for each unit and progressively merges high-weight pairs, while using anchor-guided propagation to retrieve relevant temporal neighbors.
blocks.zh: 我们比较记录压缩与普鲁因和合并基线: • 随机普鲁因随机丢弃记录直到达到目标保持比例. 它不使用内容、时间或图表信息而隔离删除记录的效果。 · KMEANs(McQueen,1967年)集群记录嵌入到各组的目标数中,并保留最接近每个集群中间行星的记录,提供了嵌入空间代表-选择基准. • DART(Wen等人,2025年)是一种基于多样性的推敲方法,它通过与一小组枢轴表示进行比较来消除高度冗余的表示. 我们把这个操作从视觉符号 改编为内存记录。 • StreamMeCo(Wang等人,2026a)用双重策略压缩结构化的内存图:它利用实体重要性和语义相似性对孤立节点和普鲁士连接节点的代表进行抽样. • 将分区记录随机合并为保留和删除的套集,然后随机将删除的记录分配给保留的记录进行合并,直至达到目标保持比例。 • ToMe(Bolya等人,2023年)在两个分区中逐步匹配类似的表述,并合并每个对应的配对. 我们通过将每个记录与最相似的对应程序相匹配,使这个符号合并程序适应记录. ^ MemForest(Wang等人,2026年b)将全球语义相似性与局部时间连续性将分区记录合并为以事件为中心的单位. 它为每个单元构建一个最大宽度的树木事件Tree,并逐渐合并高重量的对子,同时使用锚定制导的传播来检索相关的时间邻居.

blocks.en:
All compression methods start from the same uncompressed memory store built with each memory framework. For Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) and MemOS ( Li et al., 2025 ) , we use gpt-4o-mini for memory extraction and updating, and text-embedding-3-small for record embeddings, following the original
papers. For M3Agent ( Long et al., 2026 ) , we deploy gpt-4o for evaluation and use text-embedding-3-large for record embeddings, as in the original
paper. The resulting snapshots are shared by all methods before compression.
For each target reduction ratio, methods operate on the same records and are
evaluated with the same retrieval and question-answering procedure. We
preserve the original question sets and report accuracy together with
record-count and token-level statistics. Answer quality on Mem0 and MemOS is
judged with gpt-4o-mini , whereas M3Agent is evaluated with gpt-4o . All methods therefore share a common memory and evaluation

blocks.en: For ContextFolder, three iterations yield the highest accuracy on both benchmarks: 56.56% on LoCoMo and 51.8% on LongMemEval, up from 54.42% and 48.8% with one iteration.
